text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't second-guess myself anymore.
There are
people out there who only I
can make happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
They're waiting for me to put a smile on
their face
with the power of feng shui,
and I won't let them
down!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's do everything we can to
boost our
luck before the big race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our feelings in sync, we decide to
visit all
the places we can think of.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Whew! The hot water felt great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've washed away our
impurities in a
bathhouse south of
Tracen... ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next stop is the honeyade store! ♪
Today's lucky
color is lavender! So...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's grab a nutritious lavender yogurt
honeyade,
for nourishment and good
luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We knock back our gigantic drinks.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time, Tarumae. You said this is
your
first February Stakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's one of the biggest races that all
dirt
racers strive to win.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But I'll be the one seizing victory,
because I'm the
Tomakomai City Tourism
Ambassador!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I swore on the sash they gave me when I
left that I
would return home a
champion!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But... hm? Where's Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Sorry for making you wait, Tarumae. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give my all today, so do me
the same
favor, okay?  ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: R-Rickey? You, um...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're... a lot more upbeat than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, 'cause I learned my lesson.
Hesitation in the
heart leads to
hesitation when running.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have someone who believes in me!
Someone I
trust with all my heart! And
you know what she
told me?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
She told me that all I have to do is
believe in
myself and keep moving
straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Together, all the people who've helped
me out or
taught me things make up one
big environment
around me. That's the
meaning of feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm surrounded by their
warm,
reassuring kindness. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay now! I'll prove my way of doing
things
with my own running!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because if I had been putting all my
effort toward
the wrong path, there's no
way I'd be going
head-to-head with you
right now, Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right. In the end, all we can
do is
prove ourselves with our running.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, then! I'll show you just how
much I
love my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae is at the top of her
game, and
Wonder Acute is a seasoned
veteran. This will be
Copano Rickey's 
toughest opponent lineup yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But she's finally gained the unshakeable

confidence she needed. And so, the
first—and
most crucial—challenge of her
senior year begins.
